sources.role: pinned VICE source mirror; PET machine, keyboard, snapshot and ROM paths

xpet-specific keyboard boundary; no reuse of generic VICE joystick writer

paths.path: ~/.config/vice/vicerc (SDL2: sdl-vicerc; -config <file> selects a private resource file)
paths.naming: INI-like VICE resource sections; PET settings include KeyboardType and ROM resource names.

paths.path: PET keyboard resources in vicerc and the SDL virtual keyboard; KeyboardType selects graphics/business PET layouts.
paths.naming: Host keyboard events are machine-key mappings; VICE can export keyboard maps as .vkm, but xpet has no generic two-port joystick profile contract.

paths.path: Inside attached PET disk/tape images or FS-device directories; xpet has no generic per-game save sidecar.
paths.naming: Guest program files retain the attached media's image/FS-device naming; FSDevice8SaveP00 controls .p00 versus .prg.

paths.path: ~/.config/vice/PET.vsf for GTK/SDL quick snapshots; save-dialog snapshots use a chosen path and vice-snapshot-<datetime>.vsf proposal.
paths.naming: VICE snapshot container with .vsf extension, machine tag PET, and version-bound module format.

paths.path: $XDG_DATA_HOME/vice/PET (normally ~/.local/share/vice/PET), then installed VICE data paths; PET ROM resources are loaded by the PET machine.
paths.naming: Model-dependent PET ROMs include rom1g.vrs, rom2b.vrs, rom2g.vrs, rom4b40.vrs, rom4b80.vrs, rom4g40.vrs and romsuperpet.vrs; no canonical checksum is declared here.
evidence: docs:vice_3.html PET ROM files and Directory search path

paths.path: not applicable
paths.naming: No external cryptographic key file is consumed by native xpet.

linux.notes: This standalone xpet record describes the PET binary, not RetroArch's vice_xpet libretro core. The existing generic VICE native integration's .vjm joystick writer is intentionally not reused.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/net.sf.VICE/.config/vice/vicerc (SDL2: sdl-vicerc)
paths.naming: Same VICE resource syntax as native Linux under the Flatpak XDG config home.

paths.path: Flatpak VICE PET keyboard/virtual keyboard; controller device access is frontend/package dependent.
paths.naming: KeyboardType and .vkm keyboard-map semantics remain VICE-owned; no xpet joystick writer.

paths.path: Attached PET media or sandbox-visible FS-device directories.
paths.naming: Guest files stay in attached images/FS-device paths; no generic xpet sidecar.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/net.sf.VICE/.config/vice/PET.vsf quick snapshot or a user-selected .vsf path.
paths.naming: PET-tagged, version-bound .vsf snapshot.

paths.path: Sandbox VICE data directory under the Flatpak XDG data home, then installed PET data; user-supplied ROMs must be sandbox-visible.
paths.naming: PET model ROM filenames as native xpet; no canonical checksum declared.

paths.path: not applicable
paths.naming: No external cryptographic key file.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not reuse the generic VICE joystick .vjm writer for xpet: PET keyboard and virtual-keyboard state are machine-specific, and no safe standalone xpet keyboard serializer has been implemented.

notes: VICE xpet is the native PET binary and is distinct from the generic VICE native controller integration and from the vice_xvic libretro-core identity. Runtime xpet launch and effective keyboard input remain unverified.
